Hi team,

Quick summary from yesterday's debrief: Nina (final loop) was a strong technical and cross-functional fit for the Sr Model Ops role. We recommend moving to an offer. Proposed package:
- Base: $185,000
- Target EVC/opportunity: ~18% (RSU, 4y)
